fields.label: Taxpayer/Corporate Name
fields.summary: Enter the full name of the taxpayer or corporation.

fields.label: Trade Name/Franchise
fields.summary: Enter the trade name or franchise if applicable.

fields.label: DTI TRN or BNN/SEC or CDA Registration Number
fields.summary: Enter the registration number.

fields.label: Tax Identification Number (TIN)
fields.summary: Enter the TIN.

fields.label: New
fields.summary: Tick if this is a new application.

fields.label: Renewal
fields.summary: Tick if this is a renewal application.

fields.label: Transfer
fields.summary: Tick if this is a transfer application.

fields.label: Amendment
fields.summary: Tick if this is an amendment application.

fields.label: Change Name
fields.summary: Tick if you are changing the name.

fields.label: Additional Line of Business
fields.summary: Tick if adding an additional line of business.

fields.label: Others (Please specify)
fields.summary: Specify any other changes.

fields.label: Office Address
fields.summary: Enter the complete office address.

fields.label: City
fields.summary: Enter the city.

fields.label: Barangay
fields.summary: Enter the barangay.

fields.label: Street
fields.summary: Enter the street name.

fields.label: ZIP Code
fields.summary: Enter the ZIP code.

fields.label: Unit No
fields.summary: Enter the unit number.

fields.label: House/Floor No
fields.summary: Enter the house or floor number.

fields.label: Name of Building
fields.summary: Enter the name of the building.

fields.label: Business Area Total
fields.summary: Enter the total business area.

fields.label: Floor Area (sq.m)
fields.summary: Enter the floor area in square meters.

fields.label: Property owned?
fields.summary: Tick Yes or No.

fields.label: If Yes, PIN or TD Number
fields.summary: Enter the PIN or TD number if property is owned.

fields.label: Do you have tax incentives from any Government Entity?
fields.summary: Tick Yes or No.

fields.label: If Yes
fields.summary: Select applicable tax incentive/s and attach a copy of your certificate.

fields.label: Date registered
fields.summary: Enter the registration date (MM/DD/YYYY, e.g., 11/28/2025).

fields.label: Designation and Date
fields.summary: Enter your designation and the date.

fields.label: Authorized Representative
fields.summary: Enter the name of the authorized representative.

fields.label: Designated Safety Officer
fields.summary: Enter the name of the designated safety officer.

fields.label: Telephone Number
fields.summary: Enter the telephone number.

fields.label: Mobile Number
fields.summary: Enter the mobile number.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.summary: Enter the email address.

fields.label: Nature of Business
fields.summary: Enter the nature of the business.

fields.label: Line of Business
fields.summary: Enter the line of business.

fields.label: Philippine Standard Industrial Code
fields.summary: Enter the Philippine Standard Industrial Code if applicable.

fields.label: No. of Units
fields.summary: Enter the number of units.

fields.label: Capitalization or Preceding Calendar Year Gross Sales/Receipts
fields.summary: Enter the capitalization or gross sales/receipts.

fields.label: Delivery Options
fields.summary: Choose between Pick-Up or Courier.

fields.label: Mode of Payment
fields.summary: Choose between ANNUAL, BI-ANNUAL, or QUARTERLY.

fields.label: Payment Options
fields.summary: Choose between eWallet, Card, or Cash/Check.

fields.label: Signature of the Proprietor/Representative over printed name
fields.summary: Sign above your printed name.
